`enum ShaderStage`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader.source` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ShaderStage.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/source/ShaderStage.java)

The two programmable stages of a JOID shader.

## Description

[`ShaderSource.from`](/reference/pipeline/shadersource/#ShaderSource-factory-from) and [`ShaderSource.read`](/reference/pipeline/shadersource/#ShaderSource-factory-read) take the stage, so that JOID checks the declarations that the stage allows.

## Learn more

- [Write JOID GLSL](/use/learn/going-further/shaders/#write-joid-glsl)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`VERTEX`](#ShaderStage-value-VERTEX) | The stage that places each vertex: it reads the built-in attributes `aPosition`, `aTexCoord`, `aColor` and `aNormal`, writes `gl_Position`, and declares `out` variables for the fragment stage. |
| [`FRAGMENT`](#ShaderStage-value-FRAGMENT) | The stage that colors each pixel: it declares as `in` the `out` variables of the vertex stage and writes its color to `fragColor`. |

## Value details

<a id="ShaderStage-value-VERTEX"></a>

### VERTEX

`VERTEX` 

The stage that places each vertex: it reads the built-in attributes `aPosition`, `aTexCoord`, `aColor` and `aNormal`, writes `gl_Position`, and declares `out` variables for the fragment stage.

<a id="ShaderStage-value-FRAGMENT"></a>

### FRAGMENT

`FRAGMENT` 

The stage that colors each pixel: it declares as `in` the `out` variables of the vertex stage and writes its color to `fragColor`.
